def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # template sequences are contiguous runs along the bottom edge
    runs=[]; run=[]
    for v in grid[-1]:
        if v: run.append(v)
        elif run: runs.append(run); run=[]
    if run: runs.append(run)
    # non-edge singleton markers generate the template containing their color
    for r in range(h-1):
        for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]):
            if not v: continue
            seq=next((s for s in runs if v in s),None)
            if seq is None: continue
            i=seq.index(v)
            start=c-i
            for j,x in enumerate(seq):
                if 0<=start+j<w: out[r][start+j]=x
    return out
PY
